Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing additional investment authority for specified hospital districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the exemption of public hospital districts fromregulatory restrictions on investments; and adding a new section tochapter 70.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to any other investment authority granted by law,public hospital districts with annual revenues exceeding one hundredmillion dollars, and which less than five percent is derived from taxrevenues, are authorized to invest their funds and money in theircustody or possession, eligible for investment, in appropriateinvestment vehicles, as reasonably and prudently determined by thefinance or investment committees of such districts.
